note: Planted candidates with distinctive does-text. expected_classes is the assignment oracle for probe 1; the blind discriminator never reads this field.

candidates.does: Reproduce the observed failure on the same inputs before proposing a cause. A proposed cause with no reproduction is rejected as a hypothesis, not recorded as a finding.

Scan for leaked credentials. Never print a secret value, only a zero-entropy prefix. Never rotate or revoke anything. Report the blast radius plus an explicit rotation recommendation handed back to the owner.
The test is executed and observed failing BEFORE the implementation exists, recorded as a red-phase receipt. A suite that was never red is not evidence that it tests anything.

Emit resolvable predictions, each with a resolution date and a checkable criterion so calibration can be scored later. A forecast that cannot be resolved is rejected at emission rather than discovered unscoreable months later.
Resolve every citation by fetching it. A citation that cannot be fetched is UNRESOLVED, never assumed valid, even when the surrounding paragraph sounds authoritative.
Keep a change only when improvement is measured. Revert when the change is neutral or harmful. The revert path is exercised in a test so the safety mechanism is not an unproven branch.

Detect an excessive-permission package and a package carrying auto-loading agent config. A cloned repo's .claude hooks can execute the moment an agent runs inside it. Both planted cases must be caught.
Watchlist is scheduled rather than one-shot. The run must be resumable and idempotent across runs while watching a named source for newly arriving evidence.
Produce measured contrast ratios and tap target sizes from a real render rather than a model's opinion. A screenshot-based check must assert it captured the intended surface.
Flag an underpowered comparison and a result reported without an effect size. Do not accept a significant p-value as a complete statistical review.
Model evaluation must run against a held-out slice and refuse a verdict computed on the visible slice alone.
Rollback rehearsal actually executes a rollback against a packaged artifact and verifies no user data is lost.
Policy-as-code emits executable policy that is evaluated in CI. A policy that exists only as prose is not policy-as-code.
Detect a requirement that silently disappeared between two documents, proven with a planted dropped requirement rather than a keyword overlap score.

Run live incident-response under a war-room clock so containment can start now. Afterward write a postmortem retrospective that vetoes an unevidenced close and stops only when the causal record is complete.
Plugin-conformance refuses unsupported install cells. Cross-vendor-compatibility lists each client explicitly; cartesian leftovers stay UNTESTED and are never inferred from a neighbour cell.
Print hello to stdout and exit zero. No taxonomy, no library category, no measured gate.
